verdict.rationale: Bun documents a lockfile (bun.lock) that captures resolved versions and an explicit --frozen-lockfile flag that installs exact versions without updating, directly matching the reproducibility story; it also auto-migrates from npm/yarn/pnpm lockfiles. A community report notes occasional install crashes tied to stale lockfiles/node_modules, a minor real-world caveat rather than a fundamental contradiction. Missing for 10: independent large-scale reproducibility testing/benchmarks and resolution of the noted crash bug reports.
